lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZnCo₄O₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R-3m space group (No. 166), with a 33-atom unit cell and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Co and Zn centers: Co is surrounded by six O neighbors, while Zn is also coordinated by six O neighbors, with Co–O distances near 1.92–2.32 Å and Zn–O distances near 2.07–2.14 Å. Oxygen environments vary, including tetrahedral and octahedral motifs. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 33 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-sharing between Co- and Zn-centered octahedra and among O-centered tetrahedra.
